adminSchoolReports._comment: Admin App > Reports tab / Create report flow (module MRPT) on thor. Every fixture below was verified live on FCN-CHZ-PDA 2026-09-08 - see .architecture/product-knowledge/ExperienceApp/admin-reports-tab.md 10. NOTHING IN THIS SUITE CREATES A REPORT: two cases open the config dialog and leave it, and no case ever clicks Submit. The school is SHARED and actively mutated by other teams, so no value here may become an absolute-count assertion (admin-shared.md A5) - that is why there is no expected class count in this file.
adminSchoolReports._classComment: Fixture_GradeSettings_DO_NOT_DELETE is documented never-delete in admin-shared.md A7 and is the only uniquely-named class on this school - the rest are accumulation from the class-creating suites (AutoClass_CreateOnly, BulkCSV_Class1 x3+, admin-shared.md A7), and duplicates would make 'the row under test' ambiguous. It holds 0 students, which is why the footer summary below reads '0 students' - note the PLURAL with a zero count, so there is no singular/plural rule to assert.
adminSchoolReports._searchComment: TST_MRPT_TC_4 / TC_5. The search is LIVE/debounced, NOT submit-driven - the list narrows before the Search button is clicked (10.5). This corrects an assumption inherited from the Classes tab, whose search IS submit-driven.
adminSchoolReports.searchPlaceholder: Search for class name or class key
adminSchoolReports._filterComment: TST_MRPT_TC_8 / TC_9 / TC_40. All five statuses start TICKED (the register previously said unticked). The summary label is '<N> class status(es)' where N is the number of TICKED statuses, so a single applied status reads '1 class status' - singular. 'Active' is used for TC_9 because this school holds classes in several statuses, so the filter can be shown to EXCLUDE something; on the original grounding school every class was Active and the case could prove nothing.
adminSchoolReports._searchSemanticsComment: TST_MRPT_TC_6 / TC_7, grounded live 2026-09-10. The search is a SUBSTRING match, case-insensitive - NOT fuzzy. Probes: 'school license' -> 4, 'License Test' -> 4, 'schoolclass' (non-contiguous) -> 0, 'licence' (misspelt) -> 0. This matters because admin-shared.md A4 records the Library tab as FUZZY and the Classes tab as substring, and warns against inheriting either. 'bulkcsv' is used as the partial term because it is lower-case (the real classes are 'BulkCSV_*') and matched 34 classes - no count is asserted, only 'more than one, and every row contains the term'.
adminSchoolReports._orFilterComment: TST_MRPT_TC_11. Status distribution measured on FCN-CHZ-PDA 2026-09-10: Not started 10, Active 21, Ended 6, Expired 24, Deleted 49 (sum 110 = the school total). Ended + Not started are chosen as the two smallest non-zero sets, so the union stays inside one rendered page. The case measures each side in the same run and asserts |A OR B| == |A| + |B| - a class holds exactly one status, so the sets are disjoint. Nothing here is hardcoded: this school is shared and its counts churn (admin-shared.md A5).
adminSchoolReports._emptyComboComment: TST_MRPT_TC_12, REWRITTEN 2026-09-10. The register asked for a filter that matches no class, but on FCN-CHZ-PDA every one of the five statuses holds classes, so that is not reproducible here. The case instead combines a status filter with a class that is NOT in that status: Fixture_GradeSettings_DO_NOT_DELETE is Active (end date Dec 31 2036), so filtering to Ended and searching for it empties the list. Same empty-state path, verified live. NOTE this leaves 'a filter ALONE matching nothing' uncovered - that needs a school where some status is genuinely empty.
adminSchoolReports._dialogComment: TST_MRPT_TC_19 / TC_27 / TC_34. 'Class summary' is used because it is date-capable AND grade-capable (admin-reports-tab.md 2). Estimated CEFR level supports neither and would invert TC_27's expectations. reportTypeCount is 7 - the source scenario workbook lists 6 and that omission is a known, confirmed gap.
adminSchoolReports.customGradeLabel: Only include items that contribute to grade calculation
